reasons.plausibility: This is fully aligned with the established understanding that chromium- and molybdenum-rich passive films significantly enhance stainless-steel corrosion resistance, making the explanation scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: A clear set of experiments with controllable variables (alloy composition, surface prep, environment) and measurable outcomes (film composition, thickness, corrosion rate) provides a direct way to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a well-defined experimental plan to isolate and examine the role of oxide films, which is directly applicable to optimizing steel corrosion resistance in chemical-processing and nuclear-power contexts.
